1.t: When the sky is rent asunder,

2.t: And hearkens to (the Command of) its Lord, and it must needs (do so);-

3.t: And when the earth is flattened out,

4.t: And casts forth what is within it and becomes (clean) empty,

5.t: And hearkens to (the Command of) its Lord,- and it must needs (do so);- (then will come Home the full reality).

6.t: O thou man! Verily thou art ever toiling on towards thy Lord- painfully toiling,- but thou shalt meet Him.

7.t: Then he who is given his Record in his right hand,

8.t: Soon will his account be taken by an easy reckoning,

9.t: And he will turn to his people, rejoicing!

10.t: But he who is given his Record behind his back,-

11.t: Soon will he cry for perdition,

12.t: And he will enter a Blazing Fire.

13.t: Truly, did he go about among his people, rejoicing!

14.t: Truly, did he think that he would not have to return (to Us)!

15.t: Nay, nay! for his Lord was (ever) watchful of him!

16.t: So I do call to witness the ruddy glow of Sunset;

18.t: And the Moon in her fullness:

19.t: Ye shall surely travel from stage to stage.

20.t: What then is the matter with them, that they believe not?-

21.t: And when the Qur'an is read to them, they fall not prostrate,

22.t: But on the contrary the Unbelievers reject (it).

23.t: But Allah has full knowledge of what they secrete (in their breasts)

24.t: So announce to them a Penalty Grievous,

25.t: Except to those who believe and work righteous deeds: For them is a Reward that will never fail.
